name: Solr Standard
old_description: Clean, modern solar energy designed for today’s homes and tomorrow’s energy needs.
about:
Solr Standard is based in Warminster, Pennsylvania. The company was founded with the goal of delivering high-quality solar solutions without the confusion, pressure, or shortcuts often associated with the industry. No founding year or founder names are publicly disclosed.

The firm provides solar system design, project planning, and coordination with qualified installation partners for residential and commercial projects. Its services cover rooftop solar panel installation, battery storage integration, and energy storage solutions. The company also coordinates roofing work through a partner, Roofing Standard. Solr Standard does not manufacture equipment but specifies premium panels, inverters, and battery systems for each project.

Solr Standard serves homeowners, property managers, and business owners throughout Pennsylvania and New Jersey. Its residential work includes single-family homes in neighborhoods across both states, while commercial projects range from rooftop installations to larger-scale systems for businesses seeking to reduce operating costs and stabilize energy expenses.

The company says it differentiates itself through a simple, transparent process, competitive pricing focused on long-term value, and deep local knowledge of utility programs, incentives, and permitting requirements. It measures success not by the number of systems sold but by long-term system performance and client confidence throughout the project lifecycle.
